title: Japan Delights: Ryokan and Mountain Trail
alt: Snow monkeys bathing in a hot spring at Jigokudani, Japan
transport: Coaches, trains and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large four star hotel beside Shinagawa station

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city, from the Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens to the old temple lanes of Asakusa.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights beside Shinagawa station, with free time in Shinjuku and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel opposite Kyoto station, handy for the trains

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: A night in the old capital, reached by bullet train, with a guided day through the temples.

stops.name: Nagano
stops.subtitle: Nagano to Tsumago and Matsumoto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Comfortable hotel attached to Nagano station

activities.name: Tsumago post town
activities.description: A preserved post town on the old Nakasendo road, where the wooden inns and shopfronts look much as travellers found them.

activities.name: Matsumoto castle
activities.description: The black keep they call the crow castle, standing on its moat with the Alps behind it, an original from the sixteenth century.

program.name: Nagano
program.description: A night in Nagano, reached through the old post town of Tsumago and the black keep of Matsumoto castle.

stops.name: Ikaho
stops.subtitle: Ikaho to Zenkoji, the monkey park and Kusatsu
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Ryokan room · 3★ · Traditional inn at Ikaho hot spring, with tatami rooms and shared baths

activities.name: Zenkoji temple and the monkey park
activities.match: Trip to Zenkoji Temple and Monkey Park
activities.description: Nagano's great temple, then the hot spring at Jigokudani where wild macaques sit chest deep in the steaming water.

activities.name: Kusatsu hot spring town
activities.description: Free time in Kusatsu, where the hot water runs down wooden channels through the middle of the town square.

activities.name: Nikko sightseeing tour
activities.description: The lacquered Toshogu shrine in its cedar forest, the Shinkyo bridge and the Kegon falls on the way back towards Tokyo.

program.name: Ikaho
program.description: A ryokan night at a hot spring, with Zenkoji temple, the snow monkeys and Kusatsu on the way, and Nikko the next day.

stops.name: Odawara
stops.subtitle: Odawara to Kamakura and Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hot spring hotel near Odawara, at the foot of the Hakone hills

activities.name: Hokoku-ji and Sugimoto-dera
activities.match: Visit to Hokoku-ji and Sugimoto Dera
activities.description: The bamboo garden temple of Hokoku-ji and the mossy stone steps of Sugimoto-dera, the oldest temple in Kamakura.

activities.name: The great Buddha at Kotoku-in
activities.description: The thirteen metre bronze Buddha that has sat in the open air at Kamakura since the thirteenth century.

activities.name: Enoshima island
activities.description: Free time on the shrine island at the mouth of the bay, with its lanes of seafood stalls and a view back to Mount Fuji.

activities.name: Owakudani and Oshino Hakkai
activities.description: The sulphur vents at Owakudani, then the spring fed ponds of Oshino Hakkai below Mount Fuji, clear enough to count the fish.

activities.name: Lake Kawaguchi boat ride and the fifth station
activities.description: A cruise on Lake Kawaguchi and then the mountain road up to the Mount Fuji fifth station before the drive to Tokyo.

program.name: Odawara
program.description: A hot spring night near Hakone, with the temples and great Buddha of Kamakura, then Owakudani and Mount Fuji on the final day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Twelve included experiences in eight days, and a different bed almost every night. For travellers who want to see everything, this is the one.
expert.tip: Pack one small bag for the single night stops. The coach takes the big cases ahead, and you will be glad of it at the ryokan.

summary: Eight days on a touring group trip: Tokyo and a guided Kyoto day, the post town of Tsumago and Matsumoto castle, the snow monkeys with a ryokan night at Ikaho, Nikko, the great Buddha at Kamakura and Mount Fuji on the final day.
included: Included: 7 nights across five towns with daily breakfast, including a ryokan at Ikaho and a hot spring hotel near Hakone; coaches and trains throughout; guided sightseeing in Tokyo, Kyoto and Nikko; Tsumago and Matsumoto castle; Zenkoji temple and the snow monkey park; free time at Kusatsu and Enoshima; Hokoku-ji, Sugimoto-dera and the great Buddha at Kamakura; Owakudani walking tour; Lake Kawaguchi boat ride and Mount Fuji fifth station.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
